notes: Review a sample of this brand's customer tweets and drop/rename intents that never appear.

intents.description: Login, password, locked account, two-factor, profile.
Charges, invoices, payment method, failed payment.
Refunds, returns, cancelling a service or order.
Where is my order, delayed delivery, tracking, missing package.
App/site/product not working, bugs, outages, errors.
How-to questions, features, coverage, policy questions.
Complaints, poor service, compliments that are not a request.
Customer explicitly asks for a human / supervisor / DM with PII.
Does not fit the intents above, or too little text to tell.

labeling_rule: Read the customer tweet (and prior tweets in the thread if needed). Pick exactly one intent. If two apply, pick the customer's main request. Use other when unsure. Do not guess from the brand reply alone.
